method: Rendered all pages at 72 dpi, assembled six contact sheets, and visually opened every contact sheet before Gate 2 lesson production.
findings: The deck is a source reference, not a learner delivery format.
Presentation-era clipping, crowded labels, inconsistent typography, and teacher-facing wording must not carry into lessons.
The left-brain/right-brain personality framing requires explicit correction.
Myelin and CNS/PNS repair claims require current nuance rather than absolute regeneration claims.
Hearing activities require a supplied-data route and must not use uncalibrated browser tones.
All quantitative data used outside a cited source must be labelled synthetic instructional data.
